query:

Options:
A. Dev
B. Ruth
C. Marcus
D. Tomás
context:
[1] (about=Ruth, episodic, t12 @2026-07-10T20:37:00) I cannot speak to the technical aspects but the image looks beautiful. Is it possible that what you have both done this evening is exactly the kind of collaboration that makes this group worth belonging to?
[2] (about=Dev, episodic, t12 @2026-07-10T20:41:00) is that a dumb question but... if I wanted to learn PixInsight where would I even start? lowkey the walkthrough Jerome just did made more sense to me than any YouTube video I've tried
agent_answer:
The person was **Dev (A)**.

Dev said the PixInsight walkthrough Jerome just did “made more sense to me than any YouTube video I’ve tried” — acknowledging they were following it — while also asking where they would even start with PixInsight, positioning themselves as outside the narrowband-PixInsight workflow.

Ruth only said she couldn’t speak to technical aspects and praised the collaboration; she did not acknowledge following the walkthrough closely.
